disclaimer: We do not issue credits. Amounts and eligibility change. Always confirm on the official page.

programs.name: Google AI Studio / Gemini API
programs.what: Rate-limited free access to Gemini Flash-class models in the browser and via API. No company required.
programs.typical: Daily request caps on Flash / Flash-Lite. Pro models have been moving to paid.
programs.catch: Free-tier prompts may be used to improve Google products. Limits live in your AI Studio dashboard and change.
programs.best_for: Prototyping chat, tools, and vision without a card.

programs.name: Groq
programs.what: Very fast inference on a short list of open models. Email signup, OpenAI-compatible API.
programs.typical: Published per-model RPM / daily request caps (often ~30 RPM).
programs.catch: Model list is narrow. Not a frontier-lab stand-in.
programs.best_for: Snappy LLM calls in a side project.

programs.name: Cerebras Cloud
programs.what: High-throughput free tier on supported open models. Personal account is fine.
programs.typical: On the order of ~1M tokens/day on listed models — confirm in console.
programs.best_for: Batch-y prototyping when a daily request cap is tight.

programs.name: Mistral AI (La Plateforme)
programs.what: Experimentation tier for Mistral models, including code-oriented endpoints.
programs.typical: Free-mode limits are shown in your admin panel, not always on a marketing page.
programs.catch: Opaque public numbers. Check the console after signup.
programs.best_for: Trying Mistral / Codestral without a pitch deck.

programs.name: OpenRouter free models
programs.what: One key that routes to models marked :free. Personal account works.
programs.typical: Low daily request cap on free models until you optionally top up.
programs.catch: Upstream quality and data policy vary by model. Free rows appear and disappear.
programs.best_for: Sampling many models from one SDK.

programs.name: GitHub Models
programs.what: Rate-limited playground and API via a GitHub personal access token.
programs.typical: Low RPM/RPD — enough to try a model in a gist or Action.
programs.best_for: Tinkering if you already live on GitHub.

programs.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
programs.what: Daily Neuron allowance on a free Cloudflare account. Personal account is enough.
programs.typical: On the order of 10,000 Neurons/day, reset UTC. Confirm in the dashboard.
programs.catch: Neuron math is not dollars. Fine for light inference, not training.
programs.best_for: A tiny AI worker next to a free site.

programs.name: Hugging Face Inference
programs.what: Personal HF account, serverless inference, and a small monthly credit pool that changes.
programs.typical: Demo-scale. Treat any dollar figure as unstable.
programs.catch: Cold starts, rate limits, and routed-provider data policies.
programs.best_for: Trying a specific open model by name.

programs.name: Deepgram
programs.what: New-account credit for speech-to-text and TTS. No company required.
programs.typical: Often cited around $200 on signup. Confirm in console — promotions change.
programs.catch: Credit expires. Claim when you actually have audio to transcribe.
programs.best_for: Voice features on an indie product.

programs.name: AssemblyAI
programs.what: New-account transcription credit. Personal email is fine.
programs.typical: Often cited around $50. Confirm at signup.
programs.catch: One-shot credit, not a forever tier.

programs.name: fal.ai
programs.what: Signup credit across image, video, and some GPU models.
programs.typical: Often cited around $10-$20. Check billing after you join.
programs.catch: Image and video burn credit fast.
programs.best_for: Generating a few assets or testing a pipeline.

programs.name: Modal
programs.what: Monthly free compute on a personal account. Good for Python jobs and small GPU experiments.
programs.typical: Often cited around $30/month free. Confirm on Modal pricing page.
programs.best_for: A scheduled job or a small GPU script.

programs.name: OpenAI API — what you actually get
programs.what: A personal API org is allowed. You generally prepay (minimum often $5). The old automatic $5/$18 new-account credit is no longer reliable.
programs.typical: Optional data-sharing tokens if you opt in. The $2,500 startup packages go through partner VCs.
programs.catch: ChatGPT Plus is not API credit. Do not enable data sharing on private user data.
programs.best_for: When you specifically need OpenAI models and can put $5 on a card.

programs.name: Anthropic / Claude — what you actually get
programs.what: claude.ai has a free chat tier. The API is prepaid. Claude for Startups funded credits usually want a company and often institutional backing.
programs.typical: Free chat for thinking. API = buy credits.
programs.catch: Directories that list $25k-$100k Claude credits are describing a program you probably do not qualify for yet.
programs.best_for: Using Claude in the browser; paying for API only when needed.

programs.name: Vercel Hobby
programs.what: Free hosting for personal projects. Not a cloud-credit grant.
programs.typical: Bandwidth and serverless limits for a hobby site.
programs.catch: Commercial / team use may need Pro.
programs.best_for: Putting the demo on the internet.

programs.name: Supabase Free
programs.what: Free Postgres + auth + storage on a personal account.
programs.typical: One active free project — read current limits on the pricing page.
programs.catch: Some free projects pause on inactivity. This is not the startup credit pack.

programs.name: PostHog Free
programs.what: Product-analytics free tier. Personal project is fine.
programs.typical: Monthly event cap large enough for an early product.
programs.catch: Not startup credits. Just a good free plan.
programs.best_for: Knowing if anyone uses the thing you shipped.

programs.name: Skip these until you have a company
programs.what: AWS Activate Portfolio, Google for Startups six-figure packs, Microsoft Founders Hub higher rungs, OpenAI for Startups via VC, Claude for Startups funded tier, and similar programs that assume a legal entity.
programs.typical: Marketing pages quote $100k-$350k. Those numbers are not for a sole human with a GitHub account.
programs.catch: Incorporating just to chase credits is usually a worse deal than shipping on free tiers.
